title: The Boot and the Big Fish
lines: Pam and Ben got in a small blue boat.
The moon was bright and the sea was cool.
They ate sweet fruit up on the seat.
A big gray fish came up to look.
Ben shook so much that his boot fell in.
The fish took the boot and swam off!
Ben went home with just one boot on.

questions.ask: What were Pam and Ben eating in the boat?
questions.listenFor: Sweet fruit. Have them find that line and read it again.

questions.ask: How did Ben lose his boot?
questions.listenFor: He shook, the boot fell in, and the fish took it.

questions.ask: What do you think the fish did with the boot? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any idea is fine. Ask what in the story made them think so.
